scope: Independent validation of the selected 100k matrix configuration; not a full paper reproduction
selection_rule: Use entropy 0.1, the smaller of two projected schedules that solved both games for all development seeds; AR-PPO is the architecture-matched control.
code_review: BPPO and payoff source are byte-identical to selected development snapshot. Runner optimizer extraction preserves BPPO/AR initialization and ownership; default late multiplier 1 preserves constant rate. Other added branches apply only to AgentMixer or continuous actors.

evaluation.execution: ordered autoregressive local actors for both methods
evaluation.reward_unit: team reward per joint environment decision
evaluation.payoffs: accepted matrix tables; exact same frozen envs.py for both algorithms
evaluation.expectation: exact enumeration of all nine joint actions, evaluation only
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: final scheduled budget only; retain all earlier evaluations for curve diagnostics
evaluation.logged_grid: every 10 updates (10240 decisions), plus initial and exact final budget; first sustained crossing is observed only on this grid

reporting.seed_summary: mean, median, sample SD; 95% mean and median bootstrap with 10000 resamples and seed 1729 when at least five completed independent seeds
reporting.algorithm_comparison: paired BPPO minus AR-PPO on the same training seed, per game, without pooling games
reporting.relative_delta: 100*(BPPO mean-AR mean)/abs(AR mean); undefined for zero denominator
reporting.threshold_reliability: success count / all declared seeds; two-sided 95% Wilson interval, z=1.959963984540054; incomplete runs remain incomplete, not successes
reporting.validation_success: All ten BPPO seeds in each game must finish at the exact declared budget with optimal greedy reward and expected return >= 95% of payoff ceiling; this does not establish population reliability or advantage over AR-PPO.

limitations: No strict return improvement is possible over the matrix payoff ceiling.
Historical paper figure-to-logger reduction is not verified; no numerical cross-paper sample-efficiency claim.
Architecture, rollout batch and epoch choices are documented reconstruction choices, not exact appendix replication.
A failed validation is retained; further tuning must not reuse its seeds as unseen confirmation.
100k is one tenth of the BPTA paper training budget; passing this study does not confirm the 1M configuration.
